archetypes.name: artifact-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The port rewrites machine-readable review artifacts and stdout KV contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python aggregate, tally, emit, compose, and prune implementations against the retired shell contract. Focus on exact stdout keys, artifact filenames, and failure envelopes that downstream review and implement steps parse. Pay special attention to quiet-mode routing and fail-open versus fail-closed branches. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: plan-review-prune
archetypes.rationale: Embedded plan-review assets are rewritten dynamically and can silently drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the plan_review asset rewrite for prune-nit routing. Verify the decoded plan-review loop uses an argv array for both the Python CLI default and the LARCH_PLAN_REVIEW_PRUNE_NITS_SH override, and that prune-nit.env remains parseable on success and fail-open paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rollback-io
archetypes.rationale: Nit-prune plan mode must avoid partial two-file commits.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on file replacement and rollback behavior in review_aggregate.prune_nit_findings. Check same-directory temp usage, findings restoration when OOS replacement fails, and no-loss behavior when parsing or I/O errors occur. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
